name: targets_list
description: The targets the user put in AutoTuner, with the last diagnosis. Probes go only to these; a new one is added by the user (target_add asks).

name: diagnose
description: The block classifier's verdict for a target with its evidence (DNS, IP, SNI, 16 KB cut-off, QUIC…). refresh=true probes the target again and needs the probes permission.

target.description: A target from targets_list (a host name, never a URL)

refresh.description: Run the classifier again (probes the target; needs the probes permission)

name: trials_history
description: What was tried: the knowledge base's results per strategy (successes/attempts) and this session's trials.

name: catalog_functions
description: The --lua-desync functions a strategy may use, with their arguments, ranges and defaults (the bundled zapret2 catalog).

name: strategy_validate
description: Checks a strategy without running it: the Validator's errors and warnings and its id. Nothing is sent anywhere.

strategy.description: A strategy in nfqws2 syntax: only --payload=, --in-range=, --out-range= and --lua-desync= with catalog functions. Checked by the Validator before anything runs.

client.description: Client profile the strategy must survive

name: kb_query
description: The local knowledge base: what worked for a target and what worked on a provider (ASN) for anyone's targets here.

name: target_add
description: Asks the user to add a target. The AutoTuner window shows a dialog; the answer is pending until the user decides. Call again with the same arguments to see the decision. Needs the user's confirmation in the AutoTuner window.

name: trial_run
description: Runs one strategy against a blocked target: the engine (through the privileged Agent) for the target's addresses, then the probe. Returns a compact observation: L0-L3, bytes, time, successes/attempts against the baseline, what went out and what came back, the classifier's reading. Never page content.

target.description: A target from targets_list (a host name, never a URL)

strategy.description: A strategy in nfqws2 syntax: only --payload=, --in-range=, --out-range= and --lua-desync= with catalog functions. Checked by the Validator before anything runs.

strategy_id.description: A strategy id (s-…) from another answer of this server

client.description: Client profile the strategy must survive

level.description: L1 handshake, L2 full download (default), L3 page in a browser

name: search_start
description: Starts the AutoTuner search for a blocked target (the Runner: families in order, refinement, punishment pauses). Strategies put in the queue with search_enqueue go first. Long: poll search_status.

target.description: A target from targets_list (a host name, never a URL)

name: search_status
description: Progress of the search: stage, percent, tried, found strategies with ids and efficiency, the best partial one, the queue.

name: search_pause
description: Pauses the search between trials (resume=true continues it).

name: search_stop
description: Stops the search; what was found stays in search_status.

name: search_enqueue
description: Puts your candidate strategies in the Runner's queue: before the next trial of a running search, or first in the next search. Each passes the Validator; results are stored with source llm.

items.description: A strategy in nfqws2 syntax: only --payload=, --in-range=, --out-range= and --lua-desync= with catalog functions. Checked by the Validator before anything runs.

name: search_prune_family
description: Skips a strategy family for the rest of the search (search_status lists the families).

name: strategy_experiment_start
description: Runs strategy variants one by one on this PC's live traffic to the targets and measures each against a baseline; everything is reverted by itself after ttl_sec unless committed. Starting needs the user's yes in the AutoTuner window. Returns run_id; poll strategy_experiment_status. Needs the user's confirmation in the AutoTuner window.

strategy.description: A strategy in nfqws2 syntax: only --payload=, --in-range=, --out-range= and --lua-desync= with catalog functions. Checked by the Validator before anything runs.

strategy_id.description: A strategy id (s-…) from another answer of this server

targets.description: Targets from targets_list (default: all, at most 10)

items.description: A target from targets_list (a host name, never a URL)

baseline.description: Measure the targets without a strategy first (default true)

ttl_sec.description: Automatic revert after this many seconds (default 300)

keep_best.description: Keep the best variant applied until the deadline (still not committed)

name: strategy_experiment_status
description: The experiment's state (awaiting_confirmation, running, finished, failed, reverted, committed), phase, variant, seconds left before the revert, awaiting_commit.

name: strategy_experiment_result
description: The report: per variant and target the probes, success rate, score, delta to the baseline (fixed, broken, unchanged); the best variant.

name: strategy_experiment_commit
description: Keeps a variant: it becomes this PC's active protection. Needs the user's yes in the AutoTuner window; the answer is pending until then. Needs the user's confirmation in the AutoTuner window.

name: strategy_experiment_rollback
description: Reverts at once: stops the experiment's engine (a kept variant too).

name: export_preview
description: Builds an export without applying anything: the files and the main config text. save=true asks the user to save it to AutoTuner's export folder; applying to a router or zapret-gui is always done by the user. Needs the user's confirmation in the AutoTuner window.

items.description: Target and strategy pairs (default: the best known strategy of each target)

target.description: A target from targets_list (a host name, never a URL)

strategy_id.description: A strategy id (s-…) from another answer of this server

save.description: Ask the user to save the package

name: router_experiment_start
description: Tries strategy variants on the router through zapret-gui: the router measures the targets without bypass first, then applies each variant (the router's current strategy profiles stay after it) and probes the targets from the router; everything reverts by itself after ttl_sec unless committed. Each strategy passes the Validator for Linux. Starting needs the user's yes in the AutoTuner window. Poll router_experiment_status. Needs the user's confirmation in the AutoTuner window.

strategy.description: A strategy in nfqws2 syntax: only --payload=, --in-range=, --out-range= and --lua-desync= with catalog functions. Checked by the Validator before anything runs.

strategy_id.description: A strategy id (s-…) from another answer of this server

targets.description: Targets from targets_list (default: all, at most 10)

items.description: A target from targets_list (a host name, never a URL)

ttl_sec.description: Automatic revert on the router after this many seconds (default 300)

keep_best.description: Keep the best variant applied on the router until the deadline (still not committed)

name: router_experiment_status
description: The router experiment's state (awaiting_confirmation, running, finished, failed, reverted, committed), the router's phase, awaiting_commit, and whether zapret-gui is set up in AutoTuner.

name: router_experiment_result
description: The router's report: targets open without bypass, per variant and target the probes from the router, success rate, score, zapret-gui's hints; the best variant. The results are stored with source router.

name: router_experiment_commit
description: Keeps a variant on the router: it becomes zapret-gui's strategy (save=true also saves it as a user strategy and makes it active). Needs the user's yes in the AutoTuner window; the answer is pending until then. Needs the user's confirmation in the AutoTuner window.

save.description: Also save it as a user strategy on the router and make it active

name: router_experiment_rollback
description: Reverts the router at once to its state before the experiment (a kept variant too). A committed variant stays.

name: bug_report_draft
description: Drafts an issue about a problem found in AutoTuner, zapret-gui or zapret2: the fixed template with versions, the classifier's verdict, the event log tail, addresses always masked (domains on request), a suggestion where to file it and GitHub's new-issue link. Returns text only: nothing is opened or sent; show it to the user, who reviews and submits it (or uses Reports → Report a problem in AutoTuner).

about.description: A target from targets_list whose diagnosis goes in

mask_domains.description: Replace domains with d1, d2… (addresses are masked always)

name: resource_list
description: The user's strategy resources (hostlists, ipsets, blobs, Lua scripts) with version, size, the solutions that use them and, for Lua, whether a version is approved.

name: resource_get
description: One resource with its content (domains, entries, hex or lua_source) and its versions. Addresses in answers are masked as in the report.

name.description: Resource name: lower-case letters, digits, _ and - (a blob name must also be a Lua identifier: no -)

name: resource_diff
description: Line diff between two versions of a resource. For a Lua script the default is from the approved version to the current draft (what the user will be shown before approving).

name.description: Resource name: lower-case letters, digits, _ and - (a blob name must also be a Lua identifier: no -)

from_version.description: Old version (default: approved for Lua, else the previous one)

name: resource_create
description: Creates a resource from typed content: domains for a hostlist, entries for an ipset, hex for a blob, lua_source for a Lua script. Checked first; then the user decides in the AutoTuner window (pending until then, call again with the same arguments). A Lua script is created as a draft: you cannot approve it, only the user can, in the AutoTuner window after seeing the whole text and the diff. Needs the user's confirmation in the AutoTuner window.

name.description: Resource name: lower-case letters, digits, _ and - (a blob name must also be a Lua identifier: no -)

domains.description: hostlist: the domains, one per item (normalised: lower case, IDN to punycode, ^domain for no subdomains)

entries.description: ipset: IP addresses and CIDRs, one per item

hex.description: blob: the bytes in hex (spaces and : allowed), 1 to 16384 bytes

lua_source.description: lua: the script source; desync functions are function name(ctx, desync) and must not reuse zapret2's names

name: resource_update
description: Replaces the content of a resource with a new version (same fields as resource_create); the user decides in the AutoTuner window. Editing a Lua script makes a new draft: the approved version stays in effect until the user approves the new one in the window; you cannot approve it. Needs the user's confirmation in the AutoTuner window.

name.description: Resource name: lower-case letters, digits, _ and - (a blob name must also be a Lua identifier: no -)

domains.description: hostlist: the domains, one per item (normalised: lower case, IDN to punycode, ^domain for no subdomains)

entries.description: ipset: IP addresses and CIDRs, one per item

hex.description: blob: the bytes in hex (spaces and : allowed), 1 to 16384 bytes

lua_source.description: lua: the script source; desync functions are function name(ctx, desync) and must not reuse zapret2's names

name: resource_delete
description: Deletes a resource with all its versions after the user's yes. Refused while a saved or the current solution uses it (the answer names them). Needs the user's confirmation in the AutoTuner window.

name.description: Resource name: lower-case letters, digits, _ and - (a blob name must also be a Lua identifier: no -)

name: router_resource_push
description: Writes a resource to the router the user configured (zapret-gui or nfqws2-keenetic) after the user's yes in the AutoTuner window, which shows exactly what is written. Also needs the export permission. A Lua script goes only in its approved version; a draft is refused. Needs the user's confirmation in the AutoTuner window.

name.description: Resource name: lower-case letters, digits, _ and - (a blob name must also be a Lua identifier: no -)

name: router_resource_delete
description: Removes one of AutoTuner's resources from the configured router after the user's yes (zapret-gui: refused while a GUI strategy uses it; keenetic: kept as .bak, refused while nfqws2.conf refers to it). Also needs the export permission. Needs the user's confirmation in the AutoTuner window.

name.description: Resource name: lower-case letters, digits, _ and - (a blob name must also be a Lua identifier: no -)
